answer: A meadow survey cooperative gives each verified landowner a fixed daily budget for hiring agents to inspect willow trees by lantern light. All agents serving that owner share the same budget, and payment requires the owner's signed acceptance of a specific inspection. Splitting one operator into a hundred agent accounts cannot enlarge the customer's allowance. Enrollment must prevent fake landowners, and audits must catch collusion; otherwise the attack simply moves from worker accounts to customer accounts.
